# w.scrpt 0.1.0 RC12 checkpoint

Created on 2026-07-28 from `/path/to/wscrpt` after
adding direct next/previous Problem navigation for keyboard-first IDE use. The
workspace was not a Git repository, so branch and commit identity are
unavailable. RC12 supersedes RC11 as the current release candidate.

Host toolchain: `aarch64-apple-darwin`, Rust 1.95.0.

Artifacts:

- `w-0.1.0-rc12-aarch64-apple-darwin`
  - Size: 2,700,128 bytes
  - SHA-256: `4cc404678d5eb0ff39be32f3d9698142d4a9bff52bbe5fbcfd6e46b717c6a055`
- `wscrpt-0.1.0-rc12.crate`
  - Size: 377,247 bytes
  - SHA-256: `426babb764280a6b6e3829bf170665268fe11d64a05f2dbf4419ac8acfff09c1`

RC12 closure over RC11:

- Added `Esc c ]` / `code.next-problem` to jump to the next navigable Problem.
- Added `Esc c [` / `code.previous-problem` to jump to the previous navigable
  Problem.
- Navigation reuses the same LSP/task-derived Problems source as `Esc c p`,
  sorts navigable entries by path, line, and column, wraps at either end, and
  records jump history so `Esc g o` can return to the origin.
- The Problems picker remains the searchable overview; next/previous Problem
  navigation is the fast keyboard path.

Recorded host proof:

- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`: passed.
- `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo test next_and_previous_problem_navigate_sorted_locations_and_wrap --lib --locked`:
  1 passed.
- `cargo test keymap::tests --lib --locked`: 18 passed.
- `cargo test --locked --test tmux_smoke -- --nocapture`: harness passed as an
  explicit self-skip because isolated socket creation returned `Operation not
  permitted`, so tmux was not exercised on this host.
- `cargo test --all-targets --all-features --locked`: Cargo reported 538
  passed, 1 ignored, and 0 failed. The library suite contained 524 cases (523
  passed and 1 intentionally ignored subprocess helper); 6 binary and 8 real
  Unix PTY cases passed. The remaining reported pass was the tmux harness's
  explicit self-skip.
- `cargo test --doc --all-features --locked`: 3 compile-fail documentation
  tests passed.
- `cargo build --release --locked --offline`: passed.
- `cargo package --locked --offline --allow-dirty`: verified and packaged 37
  files (1.8 MiB, 368.4 KiB compressed).
- Checkpoint binary `--version`, `--health`, and `--print-default-config`:
  passed. The local health route reported `TERM=dumb`, `transport=ssh`, and
  `tmux=no`; this is not a hardware route transcript.

Open boundaries:

- Direct Problem navigation depends on the retained LSP diagnostics and latest
  retained bounded task output; task-derived entries remain snapshots, not live
  underlines.
- The tmux harness self-skipped on this restricted host. No exercised tmux
  route follows from its passing harness result.
- This checkpoint has source, validator, package, local real-PTY, and installed
  binary health evidence only. It is not approved on a real iPad, Magic
  Keyboard, Blink Shell, SSH/mosh route, tmux session, OSC 52 clipboard path,
  touch/trackpad path, or live language-server setup. The exact hardware route
  remains the open gate in `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md`.
